letter.greeting: Dear CWS Commercial Growth & Performance team,
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in Commercial Growth & Performance. Structuring business problems, analysing data and presenting clear recommendations is what I did as a Business Analyst, and I use ChatGPT and Claude daily to work faster.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence. I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP data and analytics consulting at TallyMarks Consulting, where I also presented to a client.

achievements.impact: I translated business requirements into KPI reporting in SAP Analytics Cloud and documented sources and calculations for every dashboard I built
I prepared and presented an SAP Analytics Cloud presentation to a client, who subsequently purchased it
I use ChatGPT and Claude daily and built DocuMind, an AI application with the Claude API, evaluated on a 22-question test set

letter.problems_section: I would analyse customer and revenue data, help build segments and pricing analyses in Excel and Python, and prepare clear slides for management. My business background is from analytics rather than a business degree, and my Power BI is basic, so I would learn the strategy side from your former consultants.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to the Frankfurt area and can work up to 20 hours per week, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
